title: Waiting for Armageddon
short_description: 2009 film directed by Kate Davis, David Heilbroner and Franco Sacchi

infobox.Directed by: Kate Davis, Franco Sacchi, David Heilbroner

directors: Kate Davis, Franco Sacchi, David Heilbroner

text.lead: Waiting for Armageddon is a 2009 American documentary film that studies Armageddon theology and Christian eschatology. Some evangelicals in the United States believe that bible prophecy predicts events including the rapture and the Battle of Armageddon. The documentary raises questions regarding how this theology shapes United States and Middle East relations and how it may encourage an international holy war.
text.reception: On the review aggregator website Rotten Tomatoes, 80% of 20 critics' reviews are positive.

sections.Lead: Waiting for Armageddon is a 2009 American documentary film that studies Armageddon theology and Christian eschatology. Some evangelicals in the United States believe that bible prophecy predicts events including the rapture and the Battle of Armageddon. The documentary raises questions regarding how this theology shapes United States and Middle East relations and how it may encourage an international holy war.
sections.Interviews: The documentary interviews Christians, Zionists, Jews and probes the politics and alliance between Evangelical Christians and Israel. This alliance is believed by some to set the stage for World War III.
sections.Structure: The documentary is structured around four stages of the apocalypse: 1) Rapture; 2) Tribulation; 3) Armageddon; 4) Millennialism.
